title: Smith preferred arranging to taking solos
summary: Smith says he liked hearing the horns play arrangements and making a five-piece band sound like seventeen.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: No. All I like... Mostly I didn't care nothin' about being no outstanding...playing a whole lot of solos or nothin' like that. All I would like is to raise(?)... I'd like to hear them horns play the arrangements, and voicing in them different kind of chords ...(? )...
You were more interested in that than taking solos?
You're one hell of a solo player.

Yeah, I like to take a five-piece band and make it sound like 17 pieces, especially if got a baritone in it. Yeah, to spread 'em out and make 'em sound big. Then the guys used to play them down here and say, "Man, you do those arrangements. You make a band sound... You got five pieces; you make it sound like a big band! How you do that?" And some of them boys could write music. I said, "All you got to do is just spread 'em out."
